issue.title: test_multiple_groups_expand_primary_and_switch_one_at_a_time times out mounting its screen in the broad lane
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1pn.3 note #3. ToolRun 15740c604fa23ba51d679d4c7b5472cb failed once at pilot.pause after push_screen, test_custom_gate_modal.py:188, with WaitForScreenTimeout; call duration was 74.37 seconds. The phase reports serial passes on clean base and unchanged worktree; lander independently passed the node in 0.12 seconds at 7e562f58f8. Population failure rate unknown. No proven root cause or causal active epic; topical overlap with gate work is insufficient. Search across all task statuses and past-week sweep found no duplicate. Investigate screen lifecycle/scheduling under the broad lane, preserving the assertions and without just raising timeouts. Size large because the cause is unknown.
